light.why: What every pull request push runs. Set at the 1,351 summed seconds the light tests took in run 41605766007 (pytest pinned below 9.2), plus 15%; a slow new test belongs in the heavy tier.

full.why: What a merge and the nightly run. Set at the whole suite's 8,410 summed seconds in run 41605766007, plus 15%; raising it is a one-way door, so the suite grows only when someone decides it should.
